reviews.title: Good
reviews.comment:
I’m honestly blown away by the performance of the SIX X15000 Gen5x4 SSD. I tested it right after installing, and the write speed hit an incredible 14,052 MB/s — exactly what I was hoping for from a Gen5 drive.
For gaming, it’s a complete game-changer: load screens are basically gone, and everything feels instant. On the creative side, I use it for large design files and rendering, and the speed makes my workflow so much smoother. No lag, no waiting, just pure performance.
If you’re serious about gaming or digital art, this SSD is worth every penny. Super fast, reliable, and a huge upgrade over anything I’ve used before.
reviews.author: Junxi Liang

reviews.title: So Far, so Good
reviews.comment: SIX is some china company backed by Xiaomi (another larger China company). I rolled the dice on my purchase of the 2TB drive for $240. If the performance keeps and the drive lasts, then it was well worth the price. I put my new system through a month of stress testing and so far, no problems.
